dmzauth-desc: Sign in to the DragonMineZ Wiki with Discord through Clerk. Editing rights come from roles on the DragonMineZ Discord server.
dmzauth-modal-text: Only users with access can edit the articles of the DragonMineZ Wiki.
dmzauth-modal-roles: Access comes from your role on the DragonMineZ Discord server: Wiki Maintainer, Moderator or a role with administrator permissions.
dmzauth-modal-nolonger: You are signed in, but your Discord account no longer has a role with access to edit the wiki.
dmzauth-not-configured: Signing in with Discord isn't set up on this wiki yet.
dmzauth-error: Couldn't sign you in. Try again in a moment.
dmzauth-login-text: The wiki uses your Discord account. Only members with access can edit.
dmzauth-noscript: Signing in with Discord needs JavaScript.
dmzauth-error-token: Your Discord session couldn't be verified. Try again.
dmzauth-error-expired: Your Discord session expired. Try again.
dmzauth-error-service: The sign-in service didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
dmzauth-error-nodiscord: Your account isn't linked to Discord. Sign in with Discord.
dmzauth-error-noaccess: Only users with access can edit the wiki. Your Discord account doesn't have the Wiki Maintainer, Moderator or administrator role.
dmzauth-error-username: No free username was found for your Discord account. Ask a wiki maintainer for help.
